Overview of Navarre Region (Navarre)

Navarre Region (Navarre) is located in the Navarre region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Pamplona. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Casco Histórico & Plaza Mayor, Cathedral & Alcázar, Traditional Mercado Central, Evening Paseo & tapas quarter.

RegionNavarre
Capital cityPamplona
Cities & municipalities7
Primary transport hubPamplona Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Navarre Region

Connected via Renfe AVE / Avlo / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed rail and ALSA intercity coaches. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Navarre

When visiting cities across Navarre, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Tapas & raciones
  • Jamón Ibérico de Bellota
  • Tortilla Española
  • Churros con chocolate
  • Regional DO wines

Best time to visit Navarre

Best time to visit Navarre: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.
